hooks.name: Isolation review on save
hooks.description: After saving data-access, retrieval, tool, or chat code in core, remind the agent to re-check tenant isolation invariants and tests.

action.prompt: Core code that touches tenant data was just saved. Re-check it against .kiro/steering/tenant-isolation.md: repositories take a TenantContext and add tenantId to every filter inside the repository; vector search post-filters on tenantId and active and drops foreign results; tool calls are checked against the tenant allowlist before anything else; tenant identity, session identity, and file paths never come from model output. If you changed behavior in these areas, add or update the matching test under packages/core/test/isolation and run `npm run test:isolation` when the script exists. Report any invariant you could not satisfy instead of working around it.
